taxes.name: Ontario Employer Health Tax
taxes.base: Total Ontario remuneration of the employer (associated employers share one exemption)
taxes.formula: If eligible: tax = rate(total payroll) * max(0, payroll - exemption). If group payroll > $5M: no exemption.
taxes.filing: Instalments when payroll exceeds the threshold set by Ontario; annual return by March 15

taxes.name: British Columbia Employer Health Tax
taxes.filing: Quarterly instalments above the instalment threshold; annual return by March 31

taxes.name: Manitoba Health and Post-Secondary Education Tax Levy
Newfoundland and Labrador Health and Post-Secondary Education Tax
taxes.base: NL remuneration (associated employers allocate one exemption)

taxes.name: Quebec Health Services Fund
taxes.note: Confirm 2026 rates and the total-payroll thresholds with Revenu Québec before Quebec payroll is switched on.

taxes.name: Northwest Territories payroll tax
taxes.base: Gross remuneration for work performed in the NWT

taxes.name: Nunavut payroll tax
taxes.base: Gross remuneration for work performed in Nunavut
taxes.exemption_note: Employees who normally work outside Nunavut: verify the $5,000 threshold in the Government of Nunavut payroll tax guide.
